stage: fixed before calculation of new cohort performance
purpose: Expand external evaluation without using external outcomes for feature selection, adapter tuning, cohort selection or cutoff optimization.
eligibility: Human primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma tumor specimens
Patient identifier matched one-to-one to positive overall survival time and an explicitly defined death/censor event
At least 25 eligible cases and at least 10 deaths
At least 500 shared gene symbols before training-only variance selection
Exclude adjacent normal tissue, metastases, cell lines, duplicate patients and shared patients across deposits from independent pooling
Exclude cohorts with unresolvable endpoint definition, expression scale or identifiers and report the reason

predictive_model.teacher: Unmodified archived TCGA expression-penalized Cox risk scores
predictive_model.legacy_predictions: Keep the saved GSE62452, GSE85916 and GSE71729 scores byte-for-byte; GSE71729 repair concerns channel-2 phenotype parsing only.
predictive_model.adapter_design: The legacy implementation is a platform-specific TCGA-only ElasticNet adapter, rather than one coefficient vector shared across platforms. Use the same locked recipe for new platforms and document this distinction.

new_platform_recipe.gene_symbols: uppercase, remove terminal numeric suffix, mean probe values per mapped symbol, exclude ambiguously mapped probes
new_platform_recipe.shared_genes: intersection of the platform gene symbols and TCGA expression symbols; select 3000 genes with highest variance in TCGA only
new_platform_recipe.scale: source-normalized log-scale arrays; retain source units and document; standardization mean and SD fitted in TCGA only

predictive_model.outcome_separation: Save predictions, coefficients, training scalers and SHA256 hashes before joining external survival outcomes. Do not refit in response to external performance.

endpoints_and_reporting.primary: Univariable continuous score Cox HR per within-cohort population SD (ddof=0) and Harrell C-index
endpoints_and_reporting.pooling: Fixed-effect and DerSimonian-Laird random-effects meta-analysis of log HR/SD with estimated standard errors from independent OS cohorts
endpoints_and_reporting.sensitivity: Leave-one-cohort-out pooling, including omission of GSE62452; original two-cohort estimate reported separately
endpoints_and_reporting.negative_results: Report every eligible cohort regardless of HR direction, confidence interval or P value
endpoints_and_reporting.binary_cutoff: Do not optimize or present an externally validated binary cutoff
endpoints_and_reporting.exploratory: GSE28735 cancer-death/overlap sensitivity and GSE21501 if independence from GSE71729 cannot be established

scope: This retrospective public-data extension does not add newly recruited patients or constitute prospective clinical validation. ICGC and CPTAC are optional future RNA-seq validation resources; the present expansion targets the three named array cohorts under the existing cross-platform adapter design.
